description: Interaction-responsive motion & interactivity for the TWO non-conversational demos (Virtual Pet + Digital Wardrobe), where the conversation analog is an ACTION or a garment change. Add a clickable 3D object that dispatches a REAL action/selection through the existing state/content layer (pet's applyAction via VirtualPet.doAction; wardrobe's selection setter over wardrobeOptions), add interaction-responsive camera framing keyed to that action/change, and add small ambient life gated High-only. No parallel state machine; no content invented in a scene.
steps: PET clickable: in components/pet/PetScene.tsx make the dog mesh (or a small clickable food-bowl/ball primitive within frame — no new asset) clickable. On click it must call a callback passed from components/pet/VirtualPet.tsx that invokes the EXISTING doAction(action) (which runs decayForElapsed + applyAction from lib/pet/petState.ts and persists). Choose a sensible default action for the click (e.g. clicking the dog => 'play', or clicking a bowl => 'feed'); the scene must NOT mutate stats itself — it only raises the action, exactly like the existing action buttons. Use drei useCursor for hover.

PET interaction-responsive camera: add a small, eased, LAYERED camera nudge keyed to the transient action (reuse the existing action+actionNonce props already passed to PetScene) — e.g. a quick playful push-in on 'play'/'feed', a gentle pull-back/settle on 'sleep' — easing back to the pinned rest framing. Do NOT change AIM_HEIGHT (0.55), CAMERA_DISTANCE (2.9), fov, or the group motion transforms; layer the camera move on top with drei damp easing. The scene already reacts to action via the one-shot; add the camera reaction alongside it, still driven by the same action prop (the state engine's output), not by new logic.

WARDROBE clickable: in components/WardrobeBuilder.tsx expose a callback that advances/cycles a garment category selection using the EXISTING selection state + setter (the same setter the option menus already call), reading valid indices from components/wardrobe/wardrobeOptions.ts OPTIONS (the content source of truth). In components/wardrobe/WardrobeScene.tsx make a garment region (e.g. clicking the avatar's torso => cycle 'outfit', clicking legs => cycle 'bottom') clickable so the click raises that SAME selection change. The scene must NOT hold its own garment list or invent options — it reads/dispatches through OPTIONS + the builder's setter. Use drei useCursor for hover. Do NOT disturb the OrbitControls autoRotate turntable settings.

WARDROBE interaction-responsive framing: on a garment change, apply a subtle, eased camera/target nudge that momentarily emphasizes the changed region (e.g. a small push-in toward torso when the outfit changes) then eases back to the turntable framing — LAYERED on top, without altering the turntable/orbit constants or the pinned camera constants. Key it off the selection value that changed (the content-layer output), not off click coordinates alone.

AMBIENT LIFE (both scenes): pet — the always-on breathing/liveliness already exists; add a subtle cheap ambient touch (e.g. an occasional idle ear/tail-adjacent bob is already group-based — add a gentle High-only ambient element like slow dust motes or a soft light shimmer). wardrobe — add a subtle High-only ambient element (e.g. slow floating motes or a gentle turntable-pedestal glow) that respects the Fast path. GATE heavier ambient motion to quality==='high'. No external assets.

Confirm the pet state engine (lib/pet/petState.ts) and wardrobe options (wardrobeOptions.ts) are unchanged in behavior — the clickables only call existing setters/actions. If a helper is needed (e.g. a 'cycle to next index' function for wardrobe), put pure logic in a shared non-three module or in the builder, not duplicated content in the scene.
Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build`; fix any type errors. Keep WebGL behind ssr:false wrappers.
acceptance_criteria: Pet scene has a clickable object whose handler calls VirtualPet.doAction(action) -> decayForElapsed + applyAction (lib/pet/petState.ts); the scene never mutates stats directly. The stat bars update exactly as if a button was pressed.

Wardrobe scene has a clickable garment region whose handler calls the builder's existing selection setter using indices from wardrobeOptions.OPTIONS; the scene holds no garment list of its own and invents no options.

Both scenes perform a small eased interaction-responsive camera nudge keyed to the action/selection change and ease back to the pinned framing; AIM_HEIGHT/CAMERA_DISTANCE/fov/turntable/orbit constants are unchanged.
Ambient life is visible when idle; heavier ambient motion is gated to quality==='high'. No new external asset (or the coder STOPPED and flagged one).
`npm run lint` clean (font warning aside) and `npm run build` static export succeeds with all routes prerendering.
verification: npm run lint && npm run build pass (font warning aside).

Cite the code path in findings: pet click -> VirtualPet.doAction -> applyAction (petState); wardrobe click -> builder setSelection(category, nextIndex from OPTIONS). Confirm no stat math or garment list lives in the scene.
Grep PetScene/WardrobeScene to confirm they contain no stat mutation and no hard-coded garment list; content flows via props/callbacks + wardrobeOptions.
Confirm the wardrobe OrbitControls autoRotate turntable props are byte-identical to before.
findings:
Implemented pet + wardrobe interactivity mirroring the FEAT-002 chef/coach shape (additive props + drei useCursor + maath damp3 layered camera + High-gated ambient). No new dependency (useCursor + damp3 ship with drei/maath already in use). npm run lint clean except the known @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx; npm run build static export succeeds, all five routes prerender.

PET routing (click -> state engine, scene never mutates stats):
- components/pet/PetScene.tsx: <Pet> group has onPointerDown -> onPetClick callback; drei useCursor on hover. Prop onPetClick added to SceneProps.
- components/pet/VirtualPet.tsx: passes onPetClick={() => doAction('play')}. doAction (VirtualPet) runs decayForElapsed + applyAction from lib/pet/petState.ts and persists via savePetState — the SAME path the action buttons use. Stat bars update identically to a button press.
- PET camera: CameraRig in PetScene keyed to the transient `action` + `actionNonce` props already passed by VirtualPet (state-engine output). Uses PINNED_CAM=[0,AIM_HEIGHT+0.35,CAMERA_DISTANCE] + PINNED_LOOK=[0,AIM_HEIGHT,0] with an additive damp3 offset and a nonce-armed pulse that eases back to rest. AIM_HEIGHT(0.55)/CAMERA_DISTANCE(2.9)/fov(34)/group motion transforms are byte-identical (git diff shows no +/- on those lines).
- PET ambient: DustMotes (procedural CanvasTexture points) — 7 motes/gentle drift on Fast, 20 motes/heavier drift on High (gated by isHigh = quality==='high').

WARDROBE routing (click -> builder setter over OPTIONS, scene holds no option list):
- components/wardrobe/wardrobeOptions.ts: added pure nextIndex(category,current) helper wrapping over OPTIONS[category].length (content source of truth). OPTIONS content unchanged.
- components/WardrobeBuilder.tsx: cycleCategory(cat) = setOption(cat, nextIndex(cat, selection[cat])) — setOption is the EXISTING selection setter the menu cards call. setOption also bumps a lastChange {category,nonce} signal. Both passed into WardrobeScene via sceneProps.
- components/wardrobe/WardrobeScene.tsx: GarmentHitbox (invisible box, colorWrite off) over torso -> cycleCategory('outfit'), legs -> cycleCategory('bottom'); drei useCursor on hover. The scene dispatches cycleCategory only; it holds no garment option list (the pre-existing GARMENT_URLS is a url->VRM-mesh mount map, not option content, and is unchanged).
- WARDROBE camera: CameraRig keyed to lastChange (content-layer output, not click coords). Eases a small additive dolly along the camera's own view direction + vertical bias per changed category, back to zero, WITHOUT touching OrbitControls target/minDistance/maxDistance/min|maxPolarAngle/autoRotate/autoRotateSpeed (git diff shows those lines unchanged, byte-identical) or the pinned camera=[0,1.35,2.6]/fov 40.
- WARDROBE ambient: AtelierMotes (procedural points) — 8/gentle on Fast, 22/heavier on High.

Constraints verified: no stat math or garment option list in either scene; tone mapping stays ACESFilmic (unchanged); QualityToggle remains the only quality control; WebGL stays behind next/dynamic ssr:false; all URLs via lib/asset.ts; lib/pet/petState.ts untouched (git diff empty); no build output committed.
